selection: top 8 by mutual information on the training partition
zone_rule: low = largest threshold with validation phishing recall ≥ 98% (≤ 2% of phishing sites called Safe); high = smallest threshold with validation precision ≥ 98% (≥ 98% of 'Likely phishing' sites are phishing). Safe: p < low; Suspicious: low ≤ p < high; Likely phishing: p ≥ high.
